text:
Anya: Quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the regional-model-routing change (allow per-region model override + fallback chain). Goal: low-risk rollout with customer opt-ins and automatic fallback to baseline on latency/cost/regression triggers.

Sam: Thinking slices: EU -> US -> APAC, ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Start conservative.

Priya: From SRE POV we need clear circuit thresholds. Propose fail-open to baseline when p99 > 500ms OR error_rate > 1% over 5m. Also warm caches before ramp.

Marta: Release ops prefers feature-flag gating + control-plane canary + 24h shadow mode before any traffic. Keep rollback easy.

Ethan: CS: call out customers we should offer opt-in to first wave, plus per-tenant manual opt-out. Need comms/TOU.

Anya: Draft rollout steps:
1) internal dev tier (0.5% internal traffic)
2) shadow run vs baseline for 24h (no user impact)
3) 1% EU + opt-in customers
4) 5% EU + 1% US
5) 20% per region with guardrails
6) global ramp if metrics stable

Priya: Auto-rollback triggers to add to runbook: 
- p99 delta vs baseline > +30% OR p99 > 500ms for 5m -> auto-shed to baseline
- error rate > 1% for 5m -> auto-shed
- cost per token delta > +50% -> alert + shed policy
- quality regression on eval set (similarity drop) -> pause and notify product

Sam: A/B experiment design note: control=baseline, variant=region_override. Key metrics: latency, cost-per-token, normalized quality score (prompt set), conversion/engagement lift. Minimum 2-week window for signal.

Marta: Proposed flag config snippet: 
```
flag: region_model_override
targets:
  - org: internal
    pct: 0.5
  - region: EU
    pct: 1
  - region: US
    pct: 0
rollout:
  ramp_steps: [1,5,20]
  rollback_thresholds:
    p99_ms: 500
    error_rate_pct: 1
    cost_delta_pct: 50
```

Anya: Who owns rollback automation?

Priya: I'll own automation + alerts. Runbook snippet for oncall: 
- Alert -> route to eng-oncall + product owner
- Run `./scripts/shed-to-baseline.sh <slice>` -> deploy-bot will handle deployment action
- If >3 rollbacks in 7 days, trigger postmortem and stakeholder review

deploy-bot: scheduled shadow run started for 'region_model_override' at 1736400045 :gear:

Ethan: I'll draft customer comms and the UI toggle copy. Need an admin toggle in console per-tenant.

Sam: Telemetry hooks: add header X-Redwood-Variant and prompt-level tags so we can attribute signals to variant. Also log model-id + region in traces.

Priya: Also important: shard KV caches by variant key to avoid cross-variant cache pollution during overlap.

Marta: Timeline proposal: next week internal dev ramp, week-after shadow + limited EU, full EU partial US in 2 weeks if green.

Anya: OK. Sync Wed 10am with eng-sre + cs to finalize thresholds and runbook. @Priya @Marta please confirm automation + runbook by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: Confirmed.

Marta: Confirmed.

Ethan: I'll share initial customer draft by EOD.

Anya: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
